required_sources.quote: In addition to evaluating the proposed business relationship, the Receiver may use Protected Material to design and market products competing with the disclosing company.
Each Receiver shall preserve the confidentiality of Protected Material for 24 months following each disclosure.
Within 10 calendar days after a written request from the disclosing company, the Receiver shall return or destroy all Protected Material.
If required by law to disclose Protected Material, the Receiver may disclose it without giving any notice to the disclosing company.
The Receiver may use residual information retained in unaided memory for any commercial purpose.
Prior written consent is required for assignment, except that a party may assign to any affiliate without seeking the other party's consent.
The laws of Ontario, Canada govern this Agreement.
Representatives may receive Protected Material on a need-to-know basis. The Receiver disclaims responsibility for any breach committed by those representatives.
